answer_1.quote: Topic modeling is an essential task in natural language processing that uncovers hidden thematic structures within text collections in an unsupervised way.
answer_1.outputs: topic words, topic labels, document-topic distributions

answer_2.quote: We evaluate both the topic quality and the document representation quality for topic models. For topic quality, we apply the widely used topic coherence metric, C V .

answer_3.quote: We then leverage Claude 3.5 to judge the quality of generated topics and refined topic words.
methods: judging quality of generated topics and refined topic words
